name: @joeytheman/gemini-mcp-tool

tools.name: ask-gemini
tools.description: Ask Gemini through Antigravity CLI (`agy`) for plan review, implementation critique, code review, architecture feedback, debugging, and tradeoff analysis

prompt.description: Analysis request for Gemini feedback. Use @ syntax to include files (e.g., '@largefile.js review this implementation') or ask for plan/code review feedback

model.description: Optional Antigravity model name. Verified options: 'Gemini 4 Argon (Low)', 'Gemini 4 Argon (Medium)', 'Gemini 4 Argon (High)', 'Gemini 3.8 Flash (Low)', 'Gemini 3.8 Flash (Medium)', and 'Gemini 3.8 Flash (High)'. Availability depends on your CLI version and account; check `agy models`. Some accounts also expose 'Gemini 3.1 Pro (Low)' and 'Gemini 3.1 Pro (High)'. The tier in the name is the reasoning effort. Defaults to 'Gemini 4 Argon (High)'.

sandbox.description: Use Antigravity sandbox mode (--sandbox) to restrict terminal access

changeMode.description: Enable structured change mode - formats prompts to prevent tool errors and returns structured edit suggestions that Claude can apply directly

workingDirectory.description: Working directory to run agy from. Use drive root (e.g., 'C:/' or 'D:/') to access files on that drive.

yolo.description: Map to agy --dangerously-skip-permissions. Auto-approves all tool permission requests without prompting. Use with caution.

approvalMode.description: Legacy Gemini CLI option. Only 'yolo' is supported and maps to --dangerously-skip-permissions; other values return an explicit error.

outputFormat.description: 'text' (default) returns agy's plain answer. 'json' returns agy's JSON envelope rendered as the conversation ID line, the response (or structured_output when jsonSchema is set), and a usage line. 'stream-json' is unsupported.

jsonSchema.description: Inline JSON Schema passed to agy --json-schema, which constrains the answer to structured_output. Requires outputFormat: 'json'.

effort.description: agy --effort, only for models that accept it; tiered Gemini names encode effort in the name ('Gemini 3.8 Flash (High)') and agy rejects --effort for them.

includeDirectories.description: Additional directories to include in the Antigravity workspace. Comma-separated string or array maps to repeated --add-dir flags.

debug.description: Unsupported legacy Gemini CLI option. Use agy logs for troubleshooting.

printTimeout.description: agy --print-timeout duration, such as '5m', '90s', or '10m'. If omitted, agy uses its default.

promptInteractive.description: Unsupported in MCP request/response mode because it requires an interactive TTY.

extensions.description: Unsupported legacy Gemini CLI option. Antigravity uses plugins instead of Gemini CLI extensions.

resume.description: Resume an agy conversation. true/latest/continue maps to --continue; any other string maps to --conversation <id>.

conversationId.description: Resume this exact agy conversation (--conversation <id>); wins over `resume`. In outputFormat 'json' the call errors when agy silently starts a different conversation instead of resuming this one. IDs come from the [GEMINI_CONVERSATION_ID=...] line of a previous json call.

tools.name: brainstorm
tools.description: Generate novel ideas with dynamic context gathering. --> Creative frameworks (SCAMPER, Design Thinking, etc.), domain context integration, idea clustering, feasibility analysis, and iterative refinement.

prompt.description: Primary brainstorming challenge or question to explore

model.description: Optional Antigravity model name. Verified options: 'Gemini 4 Argon (Low)', 'Gemini 4 Argon (Medium)', 'Gemini 4 Argon (High)', 'Gemini 3.8 Flash (Low)', 'Gemini 3.8 Flash (Medium)', and 'Gemini 3.8 Flash (High)'. Availability depends on your CLI version and account; check `agy models`. Some accounts also expose 'Gemini 3.1 Pro (Low)' and 'Gemini 3.1 Pro (High)'. The tier in the name is the reasoning effort. Defaults to 'Gemini 4 Argon (High)'.

methodology.description: Brainstorming framework: 'divergent' (generate many ideas), 'convergent' (refine existing), 'scamper' (systematic triggers), 'design-thinking' (human-centered), 'lateral' (unexpected connections), 'auto' (AI selects best)

constraints.description: Known limitations, requirements, or boundaries (budget, time, technical, legal, etc.)

existingContext.description: Background information, previous attempts, or current state to build upon

ideaCount.description: Target number of ideas to generate (default: 10-15)

includeAnalysis.description: Include feasibility, impact, and implementation analysis for generated ideas

workingDirectory.description: Working directory to run agy from.

tools.name: fetch-chunk
tools.description: Retrieves cached chunks from a changeMode response. Use this to get subsequent chunks after receiving a partial changeMode response.

cacheKey.description: The cache key provided in the initial changeMode response

tools.name: timeout-test
tools.description: Test timeout prevention by running for a specified duration

tools.name: live-pass
tools.description: Delegate a live UI pass to Gemini: it drives its own Playwright or Maestro MCP server, captures screenshots into a worktree-local artifact directory, looks at them itself, and returns a text verdict with per-frame observations. No image ever reaches the caller's context.

screen.description: Screen or route name, e.g. 'orders' or 'settings/profile'.

viewport.description: Viewport as WxH, e.g. '390x844' or '1280x800'. For the maestro driver, the device form factor.

expected.description: What this frame must show for a PASS. For an intentional error/empty/offline state, name the reason text and the recovery affordance.

targets.description: Every frame the pass must produce. The verdict is derived from this list: a target that produced no frame fails the pass, whether Gemini skipped it with a reason or never reported it at all — a skip explains missing evidence, it does not excuse it.

brief.description: Narrative context: base URL or app id, the served-branch marker, the seed case, navigation hints, and anything Gemini cannot infer from the targets.

workingDirectory.description: Absolute path to the worktree under test. Used as the agy cwd and workspace root; must exist and must not be a filesystem root.

artifactDir.description: Absolute directory for the captured PNGs and manifest.json. Must be strictly inside workingDirectory. Defaults to <workingDirectory>/.live-pass/<timestamp>.

driver.description: Which MCP server Gemini drives: 'playwright' for web, 'maestro' for a booted simulator.

model.description: Optional Antigravity model name. Verified options: 'Gemini 4 Argon (Low)', 'Gemini 4 Argon (Medium)', 'Gemini 4 Argon (High)', 'Gemini 3.8 Flash (Low)', 'Gemini 3.8 Flash (Medium)', and 'Gemini 3.8 Flash (High)'. Availability depends on your CLI version and account; check `agy models`. Some accounts also expose 'Gemini 3.1 Pro (Low)' and 'Gemini 3.1 Pro (High)'. The tier in the name is the reasoning effort. Defaults to 'Gemini 3.8 Flash (Medium)'.

printTimeout.description: agy --print-timeout for the whole walk. A full pass takes minutes.

yolo.description: Pass --dangerously-skip-permissions so Gemini may drive its MCP servers unattended. Without it agy denies the tool calls and the pass is BLOCKED. Refused when workingDirectory is a filesystem root.

publishCommand.description: Optional shell command run in code after validation, with {files} replaced by the shell-quoted paths of the frames that validated OK. Its stdout is returned as PR markdown. Never run on a BLOCKED pass.

conversationId.description: Resume a previous pass so Gemini can report deltas (resolved / regressions / changes) against what it saw then. The browser or simulator still starts fresh.

tools.name: screen-review
tools.description: Delegate screen review to Gemini: in 'review' mode it opens the given PNGs, inventories what each shows, and returns findings with an APPROVE / REQUEST_CHANGES verdict; in 'plan' mode it inventories the controls of a route file before anything is built. Text only — no image reaches the caller's context.

mode.description: 'review' judges screenshots after a live pass. 'plan' inventories a route file before any screenshot exists and returns no verdict.

instructions.description: The caller's reviewer prompt, verbatim. Passed through unchanged so rule citations stay exact.

context.description: Optional extra context: composition contract, changed-file list, issue text.

workingDirectory.description: Absolute path to the checkout the instructions cite. Used as the agy cwd and workspace root, so repository-relative rule paths resolve.

images.description: review mode only: absolute paths to the PNG/JPEG frames to judge. Each must exist.

changedRoutes.description: review mode: repo-relative route/component files the diff touched (from `git diff --name-only`). Every changed screen file (under an `app/` directory) that no image shows makes the review REQUEST_CHANGES; a changed file under `components/` only warns.

routeFile.description: plan mode only: absolute path to the route/screen source file to inventory. Must exist inside workingDirectory.

model.description: Optional Antigravity model name. Verified options: 'Gemini 4 Argon (Low)', 'Gemini 4 Argon (Medium)', 'Gemini 4 Argon (High)', 'Gemini 3.8 Flash (Low)', 'Gemini 3.8 Flash (Medium)', and 'Gemini 3.8 Flash (High)'. Availability depends on your CLI version and account; check `agy models`. Some accounts also expose 'Gemini 3.1 Pro (Low)' and 'Gemini 3.1 Pro (High)'. The tier in the name is the reasoning effort. Defaults to 'Gemini 3.8 Flash (Medium)'.

yolo.description: Pass --dangerously-skip-permissions. Defaults to false because a review only reads. Set it to true when the instructions ask Gemini to read repository files that are not passed as images: it reaches for a shell to do that, headless agy denies the shell, and the call then fails naming the denied action.

conversationId.description: Resume a previous review so round 2 keeps round 1's visual analysis.
